title: Diósi-Penrose OR is not standard quantum gravity

statements.text: The Diósi-Penrose proposal is sometimes called a quantum gravity scheme, but it is not part of the usual ideas of quantum gravity, and among gravitational collapse proposals only it has been tied to consciousness.

sources.quote: The DP proposal is sometimes referred to as a ‘quantum-gravity’ scheme, but it is not part of the normal ideas used in quantum gravity
